subject: Vendor onboarding: PO routing, invoice docking & advance-pay trial
messages:
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@sagehaven.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: SageHaven Finance <ap@sagehaven.io>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding & payment lane — initial info and early-pay inquiry

Hi Marcus / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited to get SageHaven into the Redwood supplier pool. I wanted to kick off vendor onboarding and flag one item that matters a lot for our cash operations: we typically invoice Net45 but are asking whether Redwood can either (a) accept Net30, or (b) participate in an early-pay program where we offer a 1.5% discount if paid within 14 days.

Attached are the vendor onboarding form and our W-9 to speed things up. A couple of questions we have up front:
- How will PO numbers map to invoice ingestion? Do you need a PO field in the invoice PDF filename?
- Is there a preferred remit email/portal or should we submit invoices to ap@sagehaven.io and cc a Redwood AP mailbox?
- If we enroll in an early-pay program, what does the enrollment/approval flow look like on your side (procurement sign-off, FP&A approval, Treasury routing)?

Happy to hop on a short call to walk through the onboarding form — Tom and our AP lead can join.

Attachments: SageHaven_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (3 pages), SageHaven_W-9.pdf

Best,
Tom Reyes
Director, Finance — SageHaven
ap@sagehaven.io | +1 (415) 555-0184
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@sagehaven.io>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, SageHaven Finance <ap@sagehaven.io>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & payment lane — initial info and early-pay inquiry

Tom — thanks for sending this over and for the clear ask. Looping in Priya from Procurement who owns PO routing and AP policy. A few quick notes from our side to make the onboarding smooth:

- PO mapping: We require a PO number on the invoice (either PDF text field or filename) that matches our PO field in the finance system. I'll attach a short mapping sheet (PO-routing-mapping.xlsx) with the expected fields.
- Remit: We prefer invoices to be submitted to invoices@redwood.ai with CC to ap-team@redwood.ai. Our portal will ingest the incoming PDF and match the PO automatically if the PO appears in the header or filename.
- Terms: Our standard new-supplier terms are Net45. We can consider Net30 for strategic vendors but that requires FP&A sign-off. Alternatively, we do run an advance-pay pilot that pays within 10 calendar days for a fee (typical range 0.5–2% depending on discount structure).

Next steps I propose:
1) Tom/your AP lead signs and returns the onboarding form (the field for "Preferred invoice email" is helpful).
2) Priya + AP will validate the bank details and W-9.
3) We evaluate early-pay enrollment: Priya, can you confirm procurement checklist and what approval levels are needed?

I can schedule a 30-minute sync tomorrow if that helps — otherwise send the completed form and we’ll take it from there.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Head of Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@sagehaven.io>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, SageHaven Finance <ap@sagehaven.io>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:21:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & payment lane — initial info and early-pay inquiry

Tom — welcome, and thanks for the attachments. A couple of operational clarifications from Procurement / AP:

- Onboarding form: please complete the banking details and confirm remit email. We will not activate a supplier without validated banking + W-9.
- PO / invoice matching: the system matches by PO number (strongest), then invoice number and total. If you can put PO_#### in the PDF header and filename that minimizes manual routing.
- Terms & early-pay: Redwood’s base for new suppliers is Net45. We evaluate early-pay requests through a pilot operated by Treasury. The baseline offer for pilot participants is typically either (a) 0.75% fee for payment inside 10 days, or (b) 1.5% for payment inside 14 days — the final fee depends on expected invoice volume and credit profile.

Operational steps for early-pay enrollment:
- Vendor returns completed onboarding form + W-9 (attached).
- Procurement runs identity/bank verification (1–2 business days).
- Treasury evaluates the requested discount and approves a product-level pilot (decision typically within 3 business days).
- Upon approval we add a routing tag (EARLYPAY:TRUE) to your vendor profile so AP prioritizes your invoices.

Tom — if you can confirm which early-pay option you prefer (10-day @ 0.75% or 14-day @ 1.5%), we’ll kick off verification. If you’d like a custom rate we can route to Treasury for an exception.

Thanks — Priya Natarajan
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@sagehaven.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, SageHaven Finance <ap@sagehaven.io>
Date: Thu, 21 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding & payment lane — initial info and early-pay inquiry

Hi Marcus / Priya — thanks for the clear path. We reviewed the options internally and would like to enroll in the pilot for the 10-day early-pay at 0.75%. We have attached the completed onboarding form and a signed W-9.

We will also format our invoices to include PO_##### in the filename and header starting with the next billing cycle. Please confirm when you have received the onboarding materials and when AP will begin the verification.

Attachments: SageHaven_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed), SageHaven_W-9.pdf (signed)

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
